units.title: Prescribed subjects (choose one, two case studies from different regions)

outcomes.text: Study how military leaders rose, led and affected their world, through two case studies from different regions.
Study causes, course and consequences of conquest, through two case studies from different regions.
Study the origins of and path to global war, through two case studies from different regions.
Study movements for rights and the protests around them, through two case studies from different regions.
Study conflicts and outside intervention in them, through two case studies from different regions.
Examine how societies and economies were organised and changed between 750 and 1400, using examples from more than one region.
Analyse why wars broke out and what they changed between 750 and 1500.
Examine how dynasties and rulers gained, held and lost power between 750 and 1500.
Examine the social, economic and cultural changes of societies in transition from 1400 to 1700.
Examine how Early Modern states were formed, governed and strengthened from 1450 to 1789.
